title: Futurola Mini Shredder for Cone Filling | Easy to Clean Stainless Steel Herb Processer with Digital Timer - Shred 0.7 Pounds in 7 Seconds | Streamline Your Herb Processing with Portable Herb Grinder
description:
About this item
Looking to streamline your cone filling process? The Futurola Mini Shredder will do just that, fill it up with your dry herb flower and turn it on. Within 7 seconds you will have finely ground herb ready to be packed into your cones.
The Futurola Mini Shredder is a necessity for all growers and processors, it will help cut hours off your work load with its high power electric grinding capabilities. Paired with the Futurola Knockbox you will be able to turn out double the product with less than half the effort.
The Futurola Mini Shredder is easy to clean, just remove the the metal grinder from the barrel and wipe down the inside chamber with rubbing alcohol. The Futurola Grinder is made from Food-Grade Stainless Steel that won't chip or contaminate your final product.
The Futurola Mini Shredder comes on a stainless steel stand allowing you to put it on your work station table or the floor. It also features a digital timer so you do not over grind your product.
We ship each Futurola Machine with insurance equal to the value of the item, a worry free order process for a high ticket item.
